description: This file defines the AgentServer class which manages server routes, health checks, shutdown procedures, and server startup for the AgentField agent, integrating with FastAPI and Uvicorn for HTTP serving and lifecycle management.

classes.name: AgentServer
classes.description: Manages server routes, health checks, shutdown, and startup procedures for the AgentField agent.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AgentServer with a reference to the agent instance.

methods.name: setup_agentfield_routes
methods.description: Sets up API routes for health, reasoners, skills, shutdown, status, info, and MCP management.

methods.name: _graceful_shutdown
methods.description: Performs a graceful shutdown, stopping MCP servers, heartbeat, and clearing registry.

methods.name: _immediate_shutdown
methods.description: Performs an immediate shutdown without cleanup.

methods.name: _format_uptime
methods.description: Formats uptime seconds into a human-readable string.

methods.name: _validate_ssl_config
methods.description: Validates SSL key and certificate files for existence and readability.

methods.name: _get_optimal_workers
methods.description: Determines optimal number of worker processes based on system resources.

methods.name: _check_performance_dependencies
methods.description: Checks availability of optional performance-enhancing dependencies.

methods.name: setup_signal_handlers
methods.description: Registers signal handlers for SIGTERM and SIGINT for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: signal_handler
methods.description: Handles shutdown signals and performs cleanup.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Starts the FastAPI server with intelligent port management, SSL, and production optimizations.
